messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — hotpatch PR needs 2x LGTM before the 23:00 UTC cutoff. This is the kv-cache warmup race fix that surfaced in canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8921 — small diff but affects warmup ordering.

Anand: :eyes: I can take a pass in ~20m. Is there a short repro or log snippet?

Maria: repro steps in the PR description. Short snippet from canary logs attached there. CI is green except for one flaky test in test-infra that looks unrelated.

Jeff: can you paste the perf numbers? Any latency regression risk?

Maria: no perf regression on our perf-run (serving p95 same within margin). This removes a small window where kv-cache returns nil leading to OOMs on 8GB nodes.

Lina: I pulled the branch locally, skimmed. Code looks fine but want one more + sanity on the rollback signal (feature flag behavior).

Sam: I can do the second LGTM after Anand if Anand thumbs up. I'll also verify the flag toggles cleanly in staging.

Anand: quick notes — left two tiny nits in the PR, both `nil` checks and a comment about a timeout constant. nothing blocking. :+1: after those are addressed.

Maria: fixed the nits and pushed. also added a short comment about why timeout=50ms is safe.

Tanya: pinging @Jeff for a quick security glance (this touches cache access patterns) — no credential surface changed but worth checking.

Jeff: looked — no auth changes, code paths insulated. :thumbsup: handing off to Sam for final eyes.

Sam: ran staging smoke, kv-warmup replicated, no OOMs, flag toggles and fallback works. giving LGTM.

deploy-bot: merge-queue: PR #8921 queued for merge as part of hotpatch window. ETA: 00:10 UTC.

Maria: Thanks all — we've got 2x LGTM and CI green. Cutting the hotpatch at cutoff if no last-minute objections. :rocket:
